cuerpo.body:
[![GitHub downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/komikku-app/komikku/v1.14.1/total?label=Downloaded&labelColor=27303D&color=0D1117&logo=github&logoColor=FFFFFF&style=flat)](https://github.com/komikku-app/komikku/releases/v1.14.1)
#### What's Changed
##### Fix
- **repo-migration**: Correct URL formatting when migrating repo (@cuong-tran)
- **delegated-sources**: Fix loading delegated sources with latest extension DSL changes (@cuong-tran)
- **chapter-hash**: Fix preference migration for existing users (@cuong-tran)

#### v1.14.0
##### New
- **Extension**: Support `TachiyomiX 1.6` (@AntsyLich)
- **Extension**: Change `extension repo` to `extension store` and add support for newer extension index format (@AntsyLich)
- **Library**: Utilize tracker for library duplicate detection (@NarwhalHorns)
- **Download**: Add option for bookmarked chapters to download dropdown (@NarwhalHorns)
- **Note**: Remove text limit of manga notes (@AntsyLich)
- **EH**: Update `EHTags` (@jobobby04)
- **MAL**: Add informative error for unapproved MAL titles (@MajorTanya)
- **Anilist**: Parse GraphQL error responses for downtime and token expiry (@itsmechinmoy)
- **Logging**: Allow disable verbose log in Debug build (@cuong-tran)

##### Improve
- **Library**: Optimize tracked library filter (@NarwhalHorns)
- **Update**: Run automatic library updates even when connected to a VPN (@AntsyLich)
- **Shortcut**: Automate app shortcuts with shortcut-helper plugin (@cuong-tran)
- **Sync**: Split "sync on add" into separate metadata and chapter fetch preferences (@cuong-tran)
- **WebDAV**: Mask WebDAV password while typing (@cuong-tran)
- **Database**: Add missing indexes to improve database query performance (@Lolle2000la)
- **Database**: Optimize database indexes and clean up schema (@cuong-tran)
- **UI**: Avoid race conditions and improve bulk selection (@cuong-tran)
- **UI**: Refactor selection state management and improve performance across various screens (@cuong-tran)
- **UI**: Add all pages of adjacent chapters in the UI instead of only the first or last three (@AntsyLich)
- **Sync**: Add sync events to SyncYomi (@kaiserbh)
- **Migrate**: Copy last page read in migrate (@jobobby04)
- **UI**: Add haptic feedback before actions (@cuong-tran)
- **MangaScreen**: Only `sync trackers` after update chapters (@cuong-tran)
- **Extension**: Change the term `Obsolete` to `Orphaned` for extensions (@AntsyLich)
- **Download**: Disable download `URL hash` inclusion by default (@cuong-tran)
- **Notification**: Use plural forms for update error notification (@sudo-ezekiel)
- **Source-api**: Check if extension supports `related manga` before making request (@cuong-tran)
- **Network**: Remove `BrotliInterceptor` from default client (@AntsyLich)

##### Fix
- **MangaDex**: Fix `MangaDex delegated` (@cuong-tran)
- **Merged-chapters**: Fix sorting `merged-manga`'s chapters by source order (@cuong-tran)
- **Anilist**: Handle GraphQL error responses on HTTP error status codes (@itsmechinmoy)
- **MangaDex**: Fix nullability issues in track creation for MangaDex (@cuong-tran)
- **Extension**: Fix extension install/update stuck at pending (@AntsyLich)
- **Extension**: Fix extension install/update stuck at installing (@AntsyLich)
- **Extension**: Fix occasional crash when mass installing/uninstalling extension using `PackageManager` (@AntsyLich)
- **Extension**: Fix ANR while installing extensions (@cuong-tran)
- **Note**: Fix crash trying to select text in notes screen (@AntsyLich)
- **Note**: Fix crash when putting app in background (@AntsyLich)
- **Logging**: Prevent app crashes from logging before `XLog` initialization (@cuong-tran)

**Full Changelog**: [komikku-app/komikku@...v1.14.1](https://github.com/komikku-app/komikku/compare/...v1.14.1)

- **shizuku**: Fix shizuku installer not updating installed extensions (@NGB-Was-Taken)
